phrases.text: Across Hotel, to holding point Runway 07 Right, hold short Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the continued progressive taxi instructions including the final hold-short.

phrases.text: Affirm
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'Yes' — the standard affirmative; never say 'yeah', 'yep', or 'roger that'.

phrases.text: Behind landing Boeing 777, line up Runway 07 Right behind, traffic in sight, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory readback restates the condition first and repeats it at the end, confirming the traffic is in sight.

phrases.text: Cancel level restriction.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The instruction deleting published SID altitude ceilings so the aircraft may climb unrestricted.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, airborne zero zero five two, contact Hong Kong Departure on one two three decimal eight.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower transfers Cathay 251 to Departure, announcing the airborne time and the new frequency 123.8.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, behind departing Boeing 777, wind 080 degrees, 14 knots, Runway 07 Right, cleared for takeoff.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: A takeoff clearance issued behind the departing Boeing 777, with current wind, authorizing Cathay 251 to begin the takeoff roll.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, behind landing Airbus 320 on two-mile final, line up Runway 07 Right behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: A conditional line-up clearance sequencing Cathay 251 behind the landing Airbus 320 on two-mile final.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, BEHIND landing Boeing 777, line up Runway 07 Right BEHIND.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical 4-part ICAO conditional clearance format: callsign, condition, traffic identification, instruction, condition repeated.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cancel level restriction, climb to Flight Level one six zero, expedite through Flight Level one zero zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure cancels the SID level restrictions and orders a climb to FL160, expedited through FL100.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cancel level restriction, climb to Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught form cancelling published step-climb caps for an unrestricted climb to FL160.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cancel takeoff clearance, hold position.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The command cancelling a takeoff clearance before the roll starts; the aircraft must remain in position.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, climb via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught form of the climb-via-SID clearance: follow the published lateral route and all altitude/speed constraints up to FL090.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, correction, QNH 1013.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller corrects their own error: the correct altimeter setting is QNH 1013, not 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cross Runway 07 Left at Hotel. Report vacated.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clearance to cross Runway 07L only at taxiway Hotel, with a requirement to report once the runway is vacated.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, de-icing completed. Type four fluid applied, start of holdover time zero zero four five, post de-icing inspection complete.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The de-icing crew reports treatment complete: Type IV fluid applied, holdover time starting at 00:45, post-treatment inspection done.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, expedite climb through Flight Level one four zero, crossing traffic opposite direction.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure orders an expedited climb through FL140 because of crossing traffic in the opposite direction.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, expedite climb through Flight Level one zero zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught command to increase vertical speed through FL100.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, hold short of Runway 07 Left on Hotel.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC instructs the aircraft to stop before the Runway 07L holding point while on taxiway Hotel.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Mandatory instruction to stop before the Runway 07L holding point; the pilot must read back the runway designator and 'hold short' verbatim.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, holdover time expired, unable departure, request return to de-icing pad for re-treatment.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The taught form for reporting expired holdover time and requesting re-treatment.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Delivery, cleared to Tokyo Haneda, OCEAN 2A departure, climb via SID to Flight Level 090, squawk 4321.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC grants the IFR clearance: destination Tokyo Haneda via the OCEAN 2A departure, climb via the SID to Flight Level 090, transponder squawk 4321.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical short form of the controller's radar identification after Mode C verification.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact. Climb via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure establishes radar contact and clears Cathay 251 to climb via the SID to FL090, complying with all published lateral, altitude, and speed constraints.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact. Passing BEKOL, climb to Flight Level one six zero, cancel level restriction.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure establishes radar contact, assigns a climb to FL160, and cancels the published SID level restrictions.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1012.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Pushback and start approved, nose to finish facing west, QNH 1012.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, standby. Traffic passing behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Wait at the gate — do not push back because another aircraft is taxiing across the pushback path behind.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, taxi to de-icing pad North via taxiway Alpha, hold short of pad entrance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears Cathay 251 to taxi to the de-icing pad via Alpha and hold short of the pad entrance.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via taxiway Alpha and Hotel. Give way to Boeing 777 crossing left to right on Bravo.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi clearance to the Runway 07R holding point via taxiways Alpha and Hotel, with an instruction to yield to a crossing Boeing 777 on Bravo.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Tower, behind landing Boeing 777, line up Runway 07 Right behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: A conditional line-up clearance: Cathay 251 may only enter the runway and line up behind the landing Boeing 777.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Tower, cross Runway 07 Left at Hotel, expedite crossing, traffic on five-mile final. Report vacated.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower clears the aircraft to cross Runway 07L at Hotel, to expedite because of traffic on five-mile final, and to report vacated.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Tower, Runway 07 Right, line up and wait.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC authorizes Cathay 251 to taxi into position on the runway and align with the centerline; throttles remain at idle — this is not permission to roll.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, negative radar contact. Scope indicates four thousand two hundred feet; you reported passing two thousand five hundred feet. Check altimeter setting and confirm level.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure reports no radar contact: the scope shows 4,200 ft versus the reported 2,500 ft, and asks the crew to check the altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE ROGER! Read back HOLD SHORT Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the 'Roger' and demands a verbatim readback of the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! Confirm TYPE FOUR fluid applied.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory correction after the pilot mistakenly read back 'Type one fluid' instead of 'Type four fluid'.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! HOLD POSITION, line up and wait ONLY.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory ATC correction after a hearback error where the pilot read back 'cleared for takeoff' instead of 'line up and wait'.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! HOLD SHORT of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller urgently rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, negative! Level restriction cancelled, climb unrestricted Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory ATC correction after the pilot read back the cancelled SID restriction at BEKOL.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! STOP CLIMB IMMEDIATELY at Flight Level one two zero!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory ATC correction after the pilot read back 'climbing to FL120' instead of 'stopping climb at FL120'.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. HOLD SHORT of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC immediately corrects the error: 'NEGATIVE' (that was wrong) -- hold short of Runway 07 Left.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. Push and start approved, facing EAST.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the clearance with the correct facing direction east.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. Push and start approved, facing NORTH.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the clearance with the correct facing direction north.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. QNH one zero one four.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the correct QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, proceed across Hotel, continue to holding point Runway 07 Right, hold short Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Continued progressive guidance: cross Hotel, continue to the Runway 07R holding point, and hold short of Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, progressive taxi approved. Follow taxiway Alpha, turn left onto taxiway Juliet, hold short of taxiway Hotel.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC approves progressive taxi and issues the first turn-by-turn instructions.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, push and start approved, facing east, QNH 1014.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Pushback clearance issued with the nose finishing pointing east and QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, push and start approved, facing north, QNH 1012.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Pushback clearance issued with the nose finishing pointing north and QNH 1012.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1014.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Cleared to push back with the nose finishing pointing west and to start engines; the local altimeter setting is QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, radar contact, Mode C verified two thousand five hundred feet. Climb to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure re-establishes radar contact with Mode C verified at 2,500 ft and clears the climb to FL090.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, contact Hong Kong Ground on one two one decimal six.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Frequency change instruction: contact Hong Kong Ground on 121.6 MHz.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, hold short Runway 07 Right.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller instructs Cathay 251 to remain holding short of the runway.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1013.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Receipt acknowledged; pushback clearance issued with nose facing west and altimeter setting QNH 1013.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, turn left immediately heading zero six zero for traffic avoidance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC acknowledges and issues a left turn to heading 060 for traffic avoidance.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, turn right on taxiway Hotel, contact Ground on one two one decimal six for return to de-icing pad.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC acknowledges and routes the aircraft back via Hotel with the ground frequency for return to the pad.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A fatal mistake — the pilot answered with 'Roger' instead of reading back the mandatory hold-short instruction, giving the controller no verification.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Runway 07 Left vacated.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports the runway is vacated — transmitted only when the entire aircraft has cleared past the holding line.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Runway 07 Right, line up and wait.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical short form of the line-up authorization: enter the runway, align with the centerline, keep throttles at idle — no permission to roll.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, slot time 0345. Clearance amendment: cancel OCEAN 2A, new departure BEKOL 3A, climb via SID to Flight Level 080. Squawk 7142.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC issues a departure slot time (CTOT 0345) and amends the clearance: OCEAN 2A cancelled, new departure BEKOL 3A, climb to Flight Level 080, new squawk 7142.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, special information Echo current: wind zero six zero degrees, two two knots gusts three five, moderate windshear reported on two-mile final Runway zero seven Left, QNH one zero one one. Acknowledge Echo.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Urgent Special ATIS (SPECI) update: new wind 060° at 22 gusting 35 knots, moderate windshear on the two-mile final for Runway 07L, QNH 1011; pilot must acknowledge the new information letter Echo.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Stand W42, request push and start, Information Echo.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot requests gate departure permission — pushback and engine start — confirming receipt of ATIS Information Echo.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Repeating the stand number after a blocked transmission.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP CLIMB at Flight Level one two zero!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught emergency command to arrest the climb immediately at FL120.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP IMMEDIATELY!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The emergency abort command used after the takeoff roll has started; the crew must stop the aircraft immediately.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP IMMEDIATELY! Cancel crossing clearance, HOLD SHORT of Runway 07 Left, go-around in progress!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Emergency instruction to stop immediately and cancel the crossing clearance because a go-around is in progress on Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP IMMEDIATELY! Cancel takeoff clearance, vehicle on the runway!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The tactical drill's emergency abort: the takeoff clearance is cancelled because an inspection vehicle is on the runway.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to de-icing pad North via taxiway Alpha, hold short of pad entrance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical ATC clearance to taxi to the de-icing pad, holding short of the pad entrance.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi clearance with a mandatory hold-short instruction before Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC instructs the aircraft to taxi to the Runway 07 Right holding point via taxiway Alpha and hold short of Runway 07 Left.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via taxiway Alpha, hold short Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi clearance to the Runway 07R holding point via taxiway Alpha, with an instruction to hold short of Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway zero seven Right via taxiway Alpha and Hotel.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears Cathay 251 to the runway holding point via Alpha and Hotel.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi via Hotel, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi instruction via Hotel with a mandatory hold-short before Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, traffic conflict overhead, stop climb at Flight Level one two zero!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The emergency command to stop the climb at FL120 because of conflicting traffic overhead.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, unable to expedite, maximum vertical speed 800 feet per minute.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory pilot response when the aircraft cannot climb faster; aerodynamic safety is never sacrificed for an expedite request.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, updated QNH one zero one four.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller issues an updated altimeter setting of QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, wind 080 degrees, 14 knots, Runway 07 Right, cleared for takeoff.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The takeoff clearance with wind information, authorizing Cathay 251 to begin the high-speed departure roll.

phrases.text: Cleared to Tokyo Haneda, OCEAN 2A departure, climb via SID Flight Level 090, squawk 4321, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the clearance verbatim (callsign last), confirming every element was understood.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level one six zero, cancel level restriction, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the climb to FL160 with the restriction cancellation.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level one six zero, cancel level restriction, expediting through Flight Level one zero zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the unrestricted climb to FL160 and expediting through FL100.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level zero nine zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the climb to FL090.

phrases.text: Climb via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the climb-via-SID clearance.

phrases.text: Contact
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'Establish communications with...' — tune the frequency and transmit a full standard initial call.

phrases.text: Correction
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'An error was made in this transmission. Correct version is...' — used immediately upon noticing your own speaking error.

phrases.text: Correction, Runway zero seven Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct way to fix a self-made error — having misstated Runway 07R instead of 07L, the pilot issues a CORRECTION.

phrases.text: Cross Runway 07 Left at Hotel, expediting, report vacated, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the crossing clearance with the expedite and report-vacated requirements.

phrases.text: Expedite crossing Runway 07 Left, traffic on 5-mile final.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Cross the runway without delay and do not stop on the runway centerline because landing traffic is on a five-mile final.

phrases.text: Expediting through Flight Level one zero zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the expedited climb through FL100.

phrases.text: Facing west
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pushback 'facing' direction always refers to where the NOSE of the aircraft will point when pushback is completed.

phrases.text: Follow Alpha, left on Juliet, hold short of Hotel, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the first progressive taxi instructions.

phrases.text: Give way to Boeing 777 crossing left to right on Bravo
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Yield right-of-way to intersecting taxi traffic — hold short of the intersection until the crossing Boeing 777 passes clear.

phrases.text: Ground from flight deck, brakes released, cleared to push.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The intercom call to the ground tug driver confirming the parking brake is off and the tug may start pushing the aircraft back.

phrases.text: Hold short of Runway 07 Left
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Mandatory instruction to stop before the runway holding point markings (two solid and two dashed yellow lines); must be read back verbatim.

phrases.text: Hold short Runway 07 Left on Hotel, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Verbatim readback of the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Holding position, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct response to a 'hold position' instruction — read back the hold, never just say 'Roger'.

phrases.text: Holding short Runway 07 Right, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard readback of the hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Delivery, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, Information Bravo, request clearance to Tokyo Haneda.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot requests an IFR departure clearance to Tokyo Haneda, reporting position (Stand Whiskey 42) and that the crew has the latest ATIS (Information Bravo).

phrases.text: Hong Kong Delivery, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, Information Delta, request clearance to Tokyo Haneda.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial contact with Delivery requesting IFR clearance to Tokyo Haneda, confirming receipt of current ATIS Information Delta.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay 251, altimeter setting one zero one two verified, level is two thousand five hundred feet. Cycling transponder.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The crew confirms the altimeter setting and actual level, and cycles the transponder to reset the Mode C encoder.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay 251, passing one thousand five hundred feet, climbing via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory initial check-in on Departure: station, callsign, passing altitude, climbing-to level, and SID.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay 251, UNABLE to expedite, maximum climb rate 800 feet per minute.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot declares unable to expedite, stating a maximum climb rate of 800 fpm at heavy weight.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, low visibility, request progressive taxi to Runway 07 Right.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: In dense fog (RVR 400m), the crew requests step-by-step progressive taxi guidance to Runway 07R.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, pushback complete, request taxi.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports the pushback is finished and requests taxi clearance.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request push and start, Information Charlie.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call requesting permission to push back from the gate and start engines, confirming receipt of ATIS information Charlie.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request push and start, Information Echo.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call to Ground requesting pushback and engine start from Stand Whiskey 42 with Information Echo.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request taxi to remote de-icing pad North.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot requests taxi from the stand to the remote de-icing pad for surface treatment.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request taxi.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot requests taxi clearance from the stand.

phrases.text: Hong Kong International Airport Information Delta. Time zero zero three zero. Runway zero seven Right in use for arrival, Runway zero seven Left in use for departure. Wind zero eight zero degrees, one five knots. Visibility one zero kilometers. Few clouds two thousand feet. Temperature two seven, dewpoint two four. QNH one zero one four hectopascals. Acknowledge information Delta on initial contact.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The full automated ATIS broadcast (Information Delta) giving the 0030Z observation: runways 07R arrival / 07L departure, wind 080° at 15 knots, 10 km visibility, few clouds at 2,000 feet, temperature 27°C, dewpoint 24°C, QNH 1014 hPa.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, approaching Runway 07 Left on Hotel, ready to cross.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot informs Tower they are approaching Runway 07L on taxiway Hotel and are ready to cross.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, holding point Runway 07 Right on Alpha, ready for departure.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports holding short at the runway holding point and ready to depart.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, holdover time has expired, unable departure, request taxi to de-icing pad for re-treatment.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports that holdover time has expired in the departure queue, declares unable to depart, and requests taxi back to the de-icing pad for re-treatment.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, negative contact on the Airbus 320, holding short Runway 07 Right.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The crew cannot see the Airbus 320, so they report negative contact and remain holding short rather than entering the runway on assumption.

phrases.text: Information Echo acknowledged, wind zero six zero at two two gusts three five, windshear Runway zero seven Left, QNH one zero one one, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Acknowledging the Special ATIS update and reading back the new wind, windshear report, and QNH.

phrases.text: Monitor
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'Listen out on frequency' — tune the frequency and listen without transmitting an initial check call.

phrases.text: Negative
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'No' / 'Permission not granted' / 'That is not correct' — used by ATC to deny requests or flag pilot readback errors.

phrases.text: Negative contact, holding short.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The report a pilot must make when the referenced traffic is not visible — never enter the runway without visual contact.

phrases.text: One two one decimal six, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the frequency change to 121.6.

phrases.text: One two three decimal eight, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the new frequency, confirming the transfer.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing south, QNH 1012, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A faulty readback — the pilot said 'facing south' instead of 'facing north', which ATC must correct.

phrases.text: Push and Start Approved, Facing West
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clearance to disconnect ground power, connect the motorized tug, push backwards out of the gate alleyway, and start the engines so the nose points west when finished.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1012, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory readback of the pushback clearance, facing direction, and altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1012.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC approves pushback and engine start with the nose finishing pointing west, confirming the local altimeter setting QNH 1012.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1013, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the pushback clearance and corrected altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1014, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory readback confirming the pushback clearance, final facing direction, and altimeter setting.

phrases.text: QNH 1013, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the corrected altimeter setting QNH 1013.

phrases.text: QNH 1014, correction, QNH 1013
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The local barometric altimeter setting (1 hPa ≈ 27–30 feet); an uncorrected 10 hPa error would create a 300-foot altitude discrepancy and a level-bust risk.

phrases.text: QNH one zero two four, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A faulty readback — the pilot said 1024 instead of 1014, a +10 hPa error the controller must catch.

phrases.text: Request progressive taxi instructions
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot asks ATC for step-by-step turn-by-turn guidance, used in low visibility or at unfamiliar airports.

phrases.text: Right on Hotel, Ground on one two one decimal six, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the return taxi routing and frequency.

phrases.text: Roger
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'I have received all of your last transmission' — acknowledges receipt only; NEVER use for instructions requiring compliance or readbacks.

phrases.text: Runway 07 Right, cleared for takeoff, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard readback of the takeoff clearance.

phrases.text: Runway 07 Right, line up and wait, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard readback of the line-up authorization.

phrases.text: Say again
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'Repeat all, or the specified part, of this message' — the mandatory request for repetition; the word 'REPEAT' is strictly forbidden in civil aviation.

phrases.text: Slot time 0345. Cancel OCEAN 2A, new departure BEKOL 3A, climb via SID Flight Level 080, squawk 7142, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the amended clearance (slot time, cancelled and replacement departures, new level and squawk) with the callsign last.

phrases.text: Squawk ident.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The command to press the transponder IDENT button so the radar tag blooms and flashes for identification.

phrases.text: Standby
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'Wait and I will call you' — the controller is busy or coordinating; do not reply, wait for ATC to call back.

phrases.text: Standby, traffic passing behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Instruction to remain static at the gate because another aircraft is taxiing across the pushback path.

phrases.text: Starting engine number two.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Announcement to the ground crew that engine number two is being ignited.

phrases.text: Station calling Ground, stepped on, unreadable. Cathay 251, say again your stand number.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Two pilots transmitted at the same instant and blocked each other, so the controller asks Cathay 251 to repeat its stand number.

phrases.text: Stopping climb at Flight Level one two zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the climb is being arrested at FL120.

phrases.text: Stopping, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the emergency stop.

phrases.text: Stopping, holding short Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot confirms immediate max braking and compliance with the cancelled clearance, holding short of Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Taxi to de-icing pad North via Alpha, hold short pad entrance, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the taxi clearance to the de-icing pad.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, crossing Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A dangerous faulty readback — the pilot said 'crossing Runway 07 Left' instead of 'hold short', which the controller must catch immediately.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, give way to the Boeing 777 on Bravo, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the taxi route and the give-way instruction.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha, crossing Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback incorrectly says 'crossing Runway 07 Left' instead of 'hold short' -- a dangerous misreadback creating a runway incursion hazard.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha, hold short Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the taxi route and the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway zero seven Right via Alpha and Hotel, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the taxi clearance to the holding point.

phrases.text: Turn left heading zero six zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the traffic-avoidance turn.

phrases.text: Type four fluid, holdover time zero zero four five, post inspection complete, request taxi Runway zero seven Right, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The taught readback confirming Type IV fluid and the holdover start time, requesting taxi to the runway.

phrases.text: Type four fluid, holdover time zero zero four five, post inspection complete, request taxi to Runway zero seven Right, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's mandatory readback confirming the fluid type and holdover start time, and requesting taxi to the runway.

phrases.text: Wilco
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'I understand your message and will comply with it' — abbreviation of 'Will Comply', used to acknowledge instructions requiring future execution.

phrases.text: Wilco, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct response to 'Cathay 251, report passing waypoint PORPA' — an instruction requiring future compliance.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing eight thousand feet climbing to Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial climb check-in: station, callsign, passing altitude and cleared level.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, climb to Flight Level one six zero, transition altitude nine thousand, standard altimeter setting one zero one three.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears the climb to FL160 and issues the transition altitude with the standard pressure setting.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level one six zero, standard set one zero one three, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the cleared level and the standard altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, stop climb at Flight Level one four zero, expedite climb through Flight Level one wun zero, traffic twelve o'clock opposite direction Boeing seven seven seven level at Flight Level one fife zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Urgent instruction: stop the climb at FL140 but expedite through FL110 due to opposite-direction traffic at FL150.

phrases.text: Stopping climb at Flight Level one four zero, expediting climb through Flight Level one wun zero, traffic in sight, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot confirms stopping the climb at FL140, expediting through FL110, with the traffic in sight.

phrases.text: Stopping climb at Flight Level one four zero, standard altimeter one zero one three, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Correct readback form: the standard keyword is 'stopping climb' (never 'level off'), and the pressure value must be read back numerically.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing Flight Level one wun zero climbing to Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Check-in while climbing: passing FL110, cleared to FL160.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, radar contact, turn left heading zero seven zero, vector for sequencing.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC establishes radar contact and issues a radar vector: turn left to heading 070 for sequencing.

phrases.text: Turn left heading zero seven zero, vector for sequencing, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the heading instruction and the vector's purpose.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, turn left heading zero two zero, descend to five thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC vectors the aircraft onto heading 020 with a descent to 5,000 ft.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, unable descent to five thousand feet on heading zero two zero due high terrain, minimum vectoring altitude is seven thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot exercises the terrain veto: unable the descent due to high terrain, stating the minimum vectoring altitude of 7,000 ft.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, maintain seven thousand feet, maintain heading zero seven zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC accepts the veto and amends the clearance: maintain 7,000 ft and heading 070.

phrases.text: Maintain seven thousand feet, maintain heading zero seven zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the amended altitude and heading.

phrases.text: Fly heading zero niner zero, descending to Flight Level one zero zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Correct readback form: say 'heading' (never 'track') and always include 'Flight Level'.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing seven thousand feet climbing to Flight Level one six zero, heading zero seven zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Departure check-in on climb: station, callsign, passing altitude, cleared level, and assigned heading.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, no speed restriction, maintain two eight zero knots or greater until passing Flight Level wun zero zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC issues a minimum-speed restriction for climb sequencing: hold 280 kt or faster until past FL100.

phrases.text: No speed restriction, maintain two eight zero knots or greater until passing Flight Level wun zero zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the speed restriction verbatim, digits spoken individually.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, cancel high speed climb, reduce speed to minimum clean speed immediately, traffic twelve o'clock eight miles crossing left to right.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Urgent tactical command: cancel the high-speed climb and slow to minimum clean speed at once due to crossing traffic.

phrases.text: Cancelling high speed climb, reducing to minimum clean speed two two zero knots, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot complies, stating the aircraft's minimum clean maneuvering speed of 220 kt.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, squawk four five two one.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC issues the assigned 4-digit octal transponder code (0000–7777).

phrases.text: Reset squawk four fife two wun, squawk Charlie, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the instruction to re-enter the transponder code and activate Mode C altitude reporting.

phrases.text: Check altimeter setting and confirm level.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC asks the pilot to verify the altimeter setting and actual level after a radar altitude mismatch.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, radar shows altitude discrepancy, reset squawk four fife two wun, squawk Charlie.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC instructs the pilot to re-enter the transponder code (clearing data corruption) and activate Mode C altitude reporting.

phrases.text: Stop squawk Charlie.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC instructs the pilot to disable Mode C altitude reporting when it differs more than 200 ft from the actual level (ICAO Doc 9432).

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, level Flight Level three three zero, request Flight Level three seven zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot checks in level at FL330 and requests a climb to the higher, more fuel-efficient FL370.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, unable Flight Level three seven zero due opposite direction traffic, climb to and maintain Flight Level three fife zero, report reaching.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC denies FL370 because of opposite-direction traffic and instead clears a climb to and hold FL350, with a requirement to report when level.

phrases.text: Climb to and maintain Flight Level three fife zero, report reaching, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the climb clearance, the report-reaching requirement, and the callsign.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, expedite climb through Flight Level three fife zero, cross SIKOU at Flight Level three fife zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Urgent instruction: climb quickly through FL350 and cross the SIKOU waypoint at FL350.

phrases.text: Expediting climb through Flight Level three fife zero, cross SIKOU at Flight Level three fife zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot acknowledges expediting the climb and confirms the SIKOU crossing restriction.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, level Flight Level three fife zero, request direct SIKOU.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot checks in level at FL350 and requests a direct routing to the downline waypoint SIKOU.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, cleared direct SIKOU, report overhead SIKOU.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears a direct great-circle track to SIKOU and requires the crew to report passing overhead the fix.

phrases.text: Cleared direct SIKOU, report overhead SIKOU, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back both the direct clearance and the mandatory reporting requirement with the callsign.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, confirm direct SIKOU, spelling Sierra India Kilo Oscar Uniform, track zero eight fife degrees.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Controller verifies the direct routing: phonetic spelling of the waypoint plus the expected track, catching FMC entry errors.

phrases.text: Direct SIKOU, Sierra India Kilo Oscar Uniform, track zero eight fife, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot confirms the waypoint spelling and track, proving the correct fix is loaded in the navigation database.

phrases.text: Manila Radio, Cathay two five one, position.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot calls the oceanic radio operator to open a position-report transmission.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Manila Radio, go ahead with position report.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The radio operator invites the pilot to transmit the position report.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, position BETTY at zero four one five, Flight Level three five zero, estimating ENKAS at zero four four two, next MONDA, request step climb Flight Level three seven zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The full ICAO 6-part position report, plus a request to step-climb to FL370.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Manila Radio, unable Flight Level three seven zero due traffic, maintain Flight Level three five zero, report ENKAS.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC denies the step climb because of conflicting traffic and keeps the aircraft at FL350, requiring a report at ENKAS.

phrases.text: Maintain Flight Level three five zero, report ENKAS, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the instruction to remain at FL350 and report passing ENKAS.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Manila Radio, confirm revised estimate for ENKAS, previous estimate zero four four two.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC asks the pilot to confirm the updated estimated time over ENKAS.

phrases.text: Manila Radio, Cathay two five one, revised estimate ENKAS zero four four six due headwind, maintaining Flight Level three five zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reports a revised ETA of 0446 over ENKAS caused by headwind while maintaining FL350.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Manila Radio, roger revised estimate ENKAS zero four four six.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC acknowledges the revised estimate for ENKAS.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, level Flight Level three fife zero, overhead SIKOU.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: En-route initial check-in: pilot reports flight level and position to the new control sector.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, contact Guangzhou Control wun tree two day-see-mal fife, CPDLC logoff.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Instruction to establish two-way comms on the new frequency and log off datalink authority.

phrases.text: Contact Guangzhou Control wun tree two day-see-mal fife, CPDLC logoff, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Correct readback of the frequency transfer instruction.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, unable contact Guangzhou on wun tree two day-see-mal fife, frequency silent.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Lost-comms report: the assigned frequency is dead after no response.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, correction, contact Guangzhou Control on secondary wun two fow-er day-see-mal zero fife, monitor guard wun two wun day-see-mal fife.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Corrected secondary frequency assignment plus an order to maintain a listening watch on the guard frequency.

phrases.text: Contact Guangzhou Control wun two fow-er day-see-mal zero fife, monitor guard wun two wun day-see-mal fife, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the corrected frequency and the guard-monitoring instruction.

phrases.text: Guangzhou Control, Cathay two five one, request twenty miles left of track due weather.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard request to deviate laterally from the airway centerline around weather.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Guangzhou Control, deviate right of track approved, report when clear of weather.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clearance authorizing a right deviation; in this scenario it is the ATC-proposed turn the pilot must veto.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, unable right of track due severe convective cells, request left of track fifteen miles, or climb Flight Level three seven zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot veto of the turn into severe cells, asserting safety authority and proposing alternatives.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, deviate left of track fifteen miles approved, maintain Flight Level three fife zero, report clear of weather.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Revised clearance for the safe left deviation with a requirement to report clear of weather.

phrases.text: Deviate left of track fifteen miles approved, maintain Flight Level three fife zero, report clear of weather, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the weather deviation clearance.

phrases.text: Guangzhou Control, Cathay two five one, encountering moderate chop Flight Level three fife zero, request descent to Flight Level three wun zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports turbulence intensity and requests a level change to escape the chop.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Guangzhou Control, unable Flight Level three wun zero due traffic, descend to Flight Level three tree zero, report reaching.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Alternative descent clearance denied at the requested level due to traffic.

phrases.text: Descend to Flight Level three tree zero, report reaching, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the descent clearance with the report-reaching requirement.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, request PIREP, confirm turbulence intensity and conditions.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC requests a standardized pilot weather report to warn downstream traffic.

phrases.text: Guangzhou Control, Cathay two five one, PIREP: Boeing seven seven seven, position SIKOU at zero fow-er two zero, Flight Level three fife zero, moderate clear air turbulence, airspeed fluctuating plus minus ten knots.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory PIREP sequence: aircraft type, position, time, flight level, turbulence intensity, airspeed fluctuation.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger PIREP, thank you.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC acknowledges the pilot weather report.

phrases.text: Taipei Control, Cathay two five one, level Flight Level three tree zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports cruising at Flight Level 330 on initial contact with Taipei Control.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Taipei Control, caution severe mountain wave activity reported west of waypoint MEGAR, moderate to severe turbulence.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Warns of severe mountain wave activity and moderate-to-severe turbulence west of waypoint MEGAR.

phrases.text: Caution mountain wave acknowledged, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the mountain wave caution to ATC.

phrases.text: Taipei Control, Cathay two five one, unable maintain Flight Level three tree zero due severe downdraft, descending through Flight Level three two five, request turn left heading zero fow-er zero to exit wave.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory ICAO call: declares inability to maintain FL330 due severe downdraft and requests an oblique escape turn to exit the wave.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, turn left heading zero fow-er zero approved, maintain Flight Level three wun zero or above, report level.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Approves the escape turn, assigns a new minimum level of FL310 or above, and requests a level report.

phrases.text: Turn left heading zero fow-er zero, maintain Flight Level three wun zero or above, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the approved escape turn and the new altitude constraint.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing Flight Level two eight zero descending to Flight Level one six zero, inbound BETTY.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call descending to the hold at the BETTY fix, reporting position inbound.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, hold at BETTY as published, Flight Level one six zero, right hand pattern, outbound time one minute, Expected Approach Time zero fow-er fow-er zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clearance to hold at BETTY with right-hand turns, 1-minute outbound leg, and EAT 0440.

phrases.text: Hold at BETTY as published, Flight Level one six zero, right hand pattern, outbound time one minute, Expected Approach Time zero fow-er fow-er zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the holding clearance including the mandatory EAT.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, update, holding delay extended due runway inspection, revised Expected Approach Time zero fife wun zero, advise holding endurance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Extends the hold due to a runway inspection, revises EAT to 0510, and requests the aircraft's holding endurance.

phrases.text: Revised Expected Approach Time zero fife wun zero, holding endurance forty-five minutes before diversion, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Confirms the revised EAT and reports 45 minutes of holding endurance before a diversion becomes necessary.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing Flight Level one eight zero descending to Flight Level one two zero, inbound LOTUS.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call to Hong Kong Radar, reporting descent to FL120 and position inbound the LOTUS fix.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, hold on the two fife zero radial of LOTUS VOR, left hand pattern, one zero mile legs, maintain maximum two wun zero knots, Expected Approach Time zero fife tree zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Non-standard holding clearance: hold on the 250 radial of LOTUS VOR with left-hand turns, 10 NM DME legs, max 210 kt, EAT 0530.

phrases.text: Hold on the two fife zero radial of LOTUS VOR, left hand pattern, one zero mile legs, maximum speed two wun zero knots, Expected Approach Time zero fife tree zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot readback of the non-standard holding clearance, confirming left-hand turns and leg distance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, confirm holding entry procedure.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC asks the crew to confirm which holding entry sector they will use.

phrases.text: Entering via Sector two teardrop entry, outbound heading two two zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reports Sector 2 (teardrop) entry with outbound heading 220°

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, level Flight Level three fife zero, approaching top of descent.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial check-in at cruise FL350, reporting approaching Top of Descent to request a descent clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, when ready descend to Flight Level wun eight zero, cross LOTUS at Flight Level wun wun zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clearance for pilot-discretion descent from the calculated TOD, with a mandatory crossing constraint at fix LOTUS at FL110.

phrases.text: When ready descend to Flight Level wun eight zero, cross LOTUS at Flight Level wun wun zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the discretion-descent clearance including the crossing constraint.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, expedite descent through Flight Level two zero zero, cross LOTUS at Flight Level wun wun zero or below due crossing traffic.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Instruction to increase the descent rate through FL200, with an altitude-window crossing constraint at LOTUS due to traffic.

phrases.text: Expediting descent through Flight Level two zero zero, cross LOTUS at Flight Level wun wun zero or below, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback confirming the expedited descent and the at-or-below crossing constraint.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing Flight Level one six zero descending via CANTO three Alfa arrival, Information Golf.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial arrival check-in: reporting descending via the CANTO 3A STAR with the current ATIS (Information Golf).

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, descend via CANTO three Alfa arrival to eight thousand feet, cross LOTUS at or above Flight Level wun wun zero, QNH wun zero wun fife.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Descend-via-STAR clearance down to 8,000 ft with a mandatory at-or-above crossing window at fix LOTUS (FL110), plus the local QNH for the altimeter transition.

phrases.text: Descend via CANTO three Alfa arrival to eight thousand feet, cross LOTUS at or above Flight Level wun wun zero, QNH wun zero wun fife, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the descend-via-STAR clearance including the crossing window and QNH.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, level restrictions on arrival cancelled, descend to eight thousand feet, maintain two wun zero knots.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Cancels only the STAR's vertical constraints; descend to 8,000 ft while continuing the charted lateral track, with a temporary speed restriction of 210 kt.

phrases.text: Level restrictions cancelled, descend to eight thousand feet, maintain two wun zero knots, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback confirming the cancelled level restrictions, the descend-to altitude and the 210 kt speed assignment.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing Flight Level wun wun zero descending to seven thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Arrival check-in: reporting passing FL110 while descending to 7,000 ft.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, transition level Flight Level wun zero zero, altimeter wun zero wun fow-er hectopascals, descend to seven thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Assigns transition level FL100 with altimeter setting 1014 hPa, and clears descent to 7,000 ft.

phrases.text: Transition level Flight Level wun zero zero, QNH wun zero wun fow-er, descend to seven thousand feet, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory readback of the transition level, QNH, and descent clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, attention all aircraft, weather update, QNH drops to wun zero zero eight hectopascals, reset altimeters.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: All-aircraft advisory: rapid QNH fall to 1008 hPa; instruction to reset altimeter subscales.

phrases.text: Reset altimeters QNH wun zero zero eight, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback confirming the altimeter reset to QNH 1008.

phrases.text: Altimeter QNH 1014 set, cross-checked, passing 9,000 ft.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard cockpit callout when passing the transition level: QNH set and cross-checked between both pilots' displays.

phrases.text: QNH one zero one four.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Announces the current QNH setting in discrete digits.

phrases.text: Passing TL, reset altimeter to QNH.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Operational shorthand: passing the transition level, switch the altimeter subscale from Standard 1013.25 hPa to local QNH.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, passing seven thousand feet descending to five thousand feet, heading two fow-er zero, Information Hotel.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Approach check-in: descending 7,000 to 5,000 ft on heading 240, with ATIS Hotel received.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, radar contact, fly heading two fow-er zero, vector for ILS Runway zero sev-en left, number two in sequence.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Radar contact established: continue heading 240 as a vector for ILS Runway 07L; the aircraft is number two in the arrival sequence.

phrases.text: Fly heading two fow-er zero, vector for ILS Runway zero sev-en left, number two, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the vector heading, ILS approach intent and sequence position, with the callsign last.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, turn right heading zero fow-er zero, descend to three thousand feet, maintain wun eight zero knots.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tactical sequencing vector: right turn to heading 040, descend to 3,000 ft and hold 180 knots until established.

phrases.text: Turn right heading zero fow-er zero, descend to three thousand feet, speed wun eight zero knots, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the heading turn, descent and speed control, with the callsign last.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, heading zero fow-er zero, descending to three thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Approach check-in: heading 040, descending to 3,000 ft, contacting the Director frequency.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, maintain two wun zero knots until wun two DME, turn left heading zero wun zero to intercept.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Intermediate approach speed restriction gate: hold 210 knots until 12 DME, with a left turn to intercept the localizer.

phrases.text: Maintain two wun zero knots until wun two DME, turn left heading zero wun zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback confirming the speed restriction gate and the intercept heading, callsign last.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, reduce speed to wun six zero knots, maintain wun six zero knots to fow-er DME.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Mandatory deceleration to the universal final approach speed gate: 160 knots to 4 DME.

phrases.text: Reduce speed wun six zero knots, maintain wun six zero knots to fow-er DME, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the 160-knots-to-4-DME final approach speed assignment.

phrases.text: Unable 160 knots to 2 DME, need to reduce at 4 DME for landing configuration.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot veto: declares unable when an ATC speed assignment would exceed flap placard limits, asserting the 4 DME deceleration gate needed for landing configuration.

phrases.text: Maintain 210 knots until 12 DME.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Standard intermediate-approach speed restriction gate.

phrases.text: Reduce to 160 knots.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Mandatory deceleration instruction for approach sequencing.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, heading zero four zero, descending to three thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial approach check-in: reporting current heading and descent to the Director controller.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, turn left heading wun zero zero, intercept localizer Runway zero sev-en left, report established.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Radar vector to intercept the ILS localizer for Runway 07L, with the mandatory report-established requirement.

phrases.text: Turn left heading wun zero zero, intercept localizer Runway zero sev-en left, report established, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the intercept vector confirming the heading, runway and reporting requirement.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, confirm localizer established.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Controller's confirmation query verifying localizer capture before the frequency transfer.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, established localizer Runway zero sev-en left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory "established" report that signals Director to transfer the flight to Tower for landing clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, contact Hong Kong Tower wun wun eight day-see-mal sev-en.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Handoff to Tower frequency 118.7 once localizer establishment is confirmed.

phrases.text: Tower wun wun eight day-see-mal sev-en, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Brief readback of the frequency transfer to Tower.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, established on localizer Runway zero sev-en left, three thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reports established on the localizer at the cleared platform altitude, awaiting the descent clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, maintain three thousand feet until glide path interception, cleared ILS Runway zero sev-en left approach.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC issues the mandatory level constraint until vertical capture and clears the ILS approach.

phrases.text: Maintain three thousand feet until glide path interception, cleared ILS Runway zero sev-en left approach, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the altitude constraint and approach clearance verbatim — descending early here is the hearback trap.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, confirm glide path intercepted.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Controller's confirmation query verifying vertical glide path capture.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, glide path intercepted, descending on glide path.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot confirms the glide path is captured and the aircraft is now descending on profile.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, contact Hong Kong Tower wun wun eight day-see-mal sev-en.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Handoff to Tower frequency 118.7 after glide path capture is confirmed.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, inbound RIVER, descending to fow-er thousand feet, Information Juliet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot's initial call to Hong Kong Director, inbound via RIVER, descending to 4,000 ft with ATIS Information Juliet.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, cleared RNP Runway zero sev-en right approach, report LNAV and VNAV established.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears the satellite-guided RNP approach for Runway 07R and requires a call when lateral and vertical guidance are captured.

phrases.text: Cleared RNP Runway zero sev-en right approach, report LNAV and VNAV established, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the RNP approach clearance and the LNAV/VNAV established reporting requirement verbatim.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, going around, loss of GPS RAIM integrity, climbing fow-er thousand feet heading zero seven three.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot initiates a go-around after losing GPS integrity past the FAF, advising ATC of the climb and heading.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, fly missed approach, climb fow-er thousand feet, contact Hong Kong Radar wun two tree day-see-mal eight.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Controller acknowledges the missed approach, confirms the climb, and hands the aircraft to Radar on 123.8.

phrases.text: Missed approach fow-er thousand feet, Radar wun two tree day-see-mal eight, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the missed approach climb and the Radar frequency transfer.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, passing fow-er thousand feet, runway in sight.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reports passing 4,000 ft with the runway in sight, the mandatory visual-contact report that makes a visual approach possible.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, cleared visual approach Runway zero sev-en right, maintain visual separation from preceding Boeing seven seven seven on fow-er mile final.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears the visual approach for Runway 07R and transfers wake turbulence separation responsibility to the pilot behind the preceding 777.

phrases.text: Cleared visual approach Runway zero sev-en right, maintain visual separation from preceding traffic, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the visual approach clearance and accepts visual separation responsibility.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, going around, visual reference lost in rain shower, climbing fow-er thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reports going around after losing visual reference in a rain shower and states the climb.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, roger, fly missed approach, straight ahead climbing fow-er thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower acknowledges the go-around and issues the missed approach instruction: straight ahead, climbing 4,000 ft.

phrases.text: Straight ahead climbing fow-er thousand feet, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the missed approach instruction concisely.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, established on localizer Runway zero sev-en left, three thousand feet, runway in sight.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reports established on the localizer at 3,000 ft with the runway in sight, setting up the circling clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, wind two fow-er zero at wun fife, cleared ILS Runway zero sev-en left approach, circle to land Runway two fife right, circling south.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC issues the wind, clears the ILS 07L approach, and authorizes circling south to land on Runway 25R.

phrases.text: Cleared ILS Runway zero sev-en left, circle to land Runway two fife right, circling south, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the ILS clearance, the circle-to-land runway, and the circling direction.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, visual reference lost in cloud, executing missed approach, climbing turn toward Runway two fife right.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reports losing visual reference while circling and executes the missed approach with a climbing turn toward the runway.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, roger, climbing turn toward runway approved, climb fow-er thousand feet on missed approach.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower approves the climbing turn toward the runway and the missed approach climb to 4,000 ft.

phrases.text: Climbing turn toward runway, climb fow-er thousand feet on missed approach, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the climbing turn and the missed approach climb.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Director, Cathay two five one, established on localizer Runway zero sev-en left, three thousand feet, request CAT three autoland.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call established on the localizer, requesting a CAT III autoland in low visibility.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Director, Low Visibility Procedures in force, CAT three operations in progress, autoland approved, maintain three thousand feet until glide path interception, contact Hong Kong Tower wun wun eight day-see-mal sev-en.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms LVP in force and CAT III operations, approves the autoland, and hands off to Tower 118.7.

phrases.text: CAT three autoland approved, Tower wun wun eight day-see-mal sev-en, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback confirming the CAT III autoland approval and the Tower frequency 118.7.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, established ILS Runway zero sev-en left, passing wun thousand two hundred feet, request RVR.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Established on the ILS at 1,200 ft, requesting the current Runway Visual Range values.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, RVR Runway zero sev-en left touchdown wun sev-en fife meters, midpoint wun fife zero meters, rollout wun two fife meters, wind calm, cleared to land Runway zero sev-en left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Reports the 3-point RVR (touchdown 175 m, midpoint 150 m, rollout 125 m) and clears the aircraft to land.

phrases.text: RVR wun sev-en fife, wun fife zero, wun two fife, cleared to land Runway zero sev-en left, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory readback of all three RVR values plus the landing clearance.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, four mile final, Runway zero sev-en left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call on a four-mile final for Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, wind zero sev-en zero degrees wun fife knots, gusts two fow-er knots, Runway zero sev-en left, cleared to land.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Passes the surface wind with gusts and issues the landing clearance for Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Wind zero sev-en zero at wun fife gusts two fow-er, Runway zero sev-en left, cleared to land, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory readback of the wind and the landing clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, caution, wind shift, wind two fife zero degrees wun fow-er knots gusts two zero knots, tailwind component wun fow-er knots.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Warns of a wind shift creating a 14-knot tailwind component.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, going around, tailwind exceeds landing limits, climbing fow-er thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Executes a go-around because the tailwind exceeds the 10-knot landing limit.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, fly missed approach, straight ahead climbing fow-er thousand feet, contact Departure wun two tree day-see-mal eight.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Approves the missed approach, instructs a straight-ahead climb to 4,000 ft and handoff to Departure 123.8.

phrases.text: Straight ahead climbing fow-er thousand feet, Departure wun two tree day-see-mal eight, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the missed-approach climb and the Departure frequency change.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, late downwind Runway zero sev-en right, request touch-and-go.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Requests a touch-and-go while late downwind for Runway 07R.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, number two following Diamond four zero on two mile final, report final.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Sequences Cathay 251 as number two behind Diamond 40 on a two-mile final and asks it to report final.

phrases.text: Number two, follow Diamond, report final, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the number-two sequence and the report-final instruction.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, final Runway zero sev-en right, touch-and-go.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports final for Runway 07R intending a touch-and-go.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, wind zero six zero degrees wun zero knots, Runway zero sev-en right, cleared touch-and-go.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Passes the surface wind and issues the touch-and-go clearance for Runway 07R.

phrases.text: Wind zero six zero at wun zero, Runway zero sev-en right, cleared touch-and-go, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the wind and the touch-and-go clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, go around immediately, aircraft stopped on runway!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Orders an immediate go-around because an aircraft has stopped on the runway.

phrases.text: Going around immediately, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the immediate go-around instruction.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, two mile final, Runway zero sev-en left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports two miles out on final for Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, cancel landing clearance, go around immediately, preceding aircraft disabled on runway!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Cancels the landing clearance and orders an immediate go-around because a preceding aircraft is disabled on the runway.

phrases.text: Cancel landing clearance, going around immediately, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the cancelled landing clearance and the immediate go-around.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, fly missed approach, straight ahead climbing fow-er thousand feet, contact Departure wun two tree day-see-mal eight.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Instructs Cathay 251 to fly the missed approach straight ahead to 4,000 feet and contact Departure on 123.8.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay two five one, passing two thousand feet climbing fow-er thousand feet, going around Runway zero sev-en left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Checks in with Departure passing 2,000 feet climbing to 4,000 feet after going around from Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact, climb five thousand feet, report intentions.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms radar contact, clears Cathay 251 to 5,000 feet, and asks for its intentions.

phrases.text: Climb five thousand feet, request radar vectors for another ILS Runway zero sev-en left, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the climb to 5,000 feet and request for radar vectors for another ILS approach to Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, runway vacated via Alpha fow-er.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports the runway vacated via taxiway Alpha 4.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, roger, contact Ground wun two wun day-see-mal six.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the vacated report and instructs the aircraft to contact Ground on 121.6.

phrases.text: Ground wun two wun day-see-mal six, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the Ground frequency 121.6.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay two five one, vacated Runway zero sev-en left at Alpha fow-er, request taxi to gate.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports vacated Runway 07L at Alpha 4 and requests taxi to the gate.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Ground, taxi to Stand November two fow-er via taxiway Golf, hold short of taxiway Bravo.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clears the aircraft to taxi to Stand N24 via taxiway Golf, holding short of taxiway Bravo.

phrases.text: Taxi to Stand November two fow-er via Golf, hold short of taxiway Bravo, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the taxi clearance to Stand N24 via Golf with the hold-short of Bravo.

phrases.text: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares an urgency condition to Hong Kong Radar.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, go ahead with your PAN PAN.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Invites the aircraft to transmit its urgency message.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Boeing seven seven seven, position SIKOU, Flight Level three fife zero, passenger medical emergency, passenger unconscious, request immediate priority return to Hong Kong, direct SIRA, descending to Flight Level wun zero zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports a passenger medical emergency with an unconscious passenger and requests an immediate priority return to Hong Kong via SIRA, descending to FL100.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, roger PAN PAN, cleared direct SIRA, descend to Flight Level wun zero zero, priority granted, advise persons on board and fuel endurance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the PAN PAN, clears the aircraft direct SIRA descending to FL100 with priority, and asks for persons on board and fuel endurance.

phrases.text: Cleared direct SIRA, descend Flight Level wun zero zero, persons on board two eight fow-er, fuel endurance fow-er hours, request overweight landing Runway zero sev-en left, and ambulance on arrival.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
