phrases.meaning: Reads back the clearance, reports 284 persons on board and 4 hours fuel endurance, and requests an overweight landing on Runway 07L with an ambulance on arrival.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, emergency medical services alerted, expect Runway zero sev-en left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms emergency medical services are alerted and to expect Runway 07L.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing one thousand five hundred feet, engine fire number two engine, shutting down, squawking seven seven zero zero. Request immediate return, radar vectors ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares distress for an engine fire, reports position and altitude, sets squawk 7700, and requests an immediate return with radar vectors for ILS runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, MAYDAY acknowledged. Squawk seven seven zero zero observed. Turn left heading zero four zero, climb and maintain four thousand feet. You have priority for runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, confirms squawk 7700 observed, and gives priority vectors: left heading 040, climb and maintain 4,000 feet for runway 07L.

phrases.text: Left heading zero four zero, climb and maintain four thousand feet, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the heading and altitude clearance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, when able, report persons on board and fuel endurance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Asks the crew to report persons on board and fuel endurance when able.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, souls on board two hundred and forty, endurance three hours one five minutes, hazardous cargo nil. Engine secured, fire extinguished.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports 240 souls on board, 3 hours 15 minutes fuel endurance, no hazardous cargo, and that the engine is secured and the fire extinguished.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Emergency services notified, standing by runway zero seven left. Continue heading zero four zero, vectoring for downwind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms emergency services are notified and standing by runway 07L, and continues vectors for downwind.

phrases.text: Heading zero four zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back continuing heading 040.

phrases.text: TRANSMITTING BLIND DUE TO RECEIVER FAILURE. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, squawking seven six zero zero, passing six thousand feet, heading zero four zero, proceeding direct to LOTUS for ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Broadcasts blind (receiver failed): reports squawk 7600, passing 6,000 feet, heading 040, proceeding direct to LOTUS for ILS runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, squawk seven six zero zero observed. You are unreadable. If you read Hong Kong Radar, turn left heading zero two zero, or squawk ident.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms squawk 7600 observed, tells the aircraft it is unreadable, and tests whether it can still hear by asking for a left turn to heading 020 or a squawk ident.

phrases.text: TRANSMITTING BLIND DUE TO RECEIVER FAILURE. Cathay two five one, turning left heading zero two zero, squawking ident. Continuing descent to four thousand feet to intercept localizer.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Confirms turning left to heading 020 and squawking ident, continuing descent to 4,000 feet to intercept the localizer.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, ident observed. Hong Kong Radar acknowledges your turn. You are number one for approach. All conflicting traffic cleared.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms the ident was observed, acknowledges the turn, and clears the aircraft as number one for approach with conflicting traffic cleared.

phrases.text: TRANSMITTING BLIND DUE TO RECEIVER FAILURE. Cathay two five one, established on localizer runway zero seven left, four miles, descending on glide path. Watching for Tower light signals.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports established on the localizer for runway 07L, 4 miles out, descending on the glide path, and watching for tower light signals.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower transmitting blind. Steady green light gun signal displayed from tower. Cleared to land runway zero seven left, wind zero eight zero at one zero knots.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower transmits blind: a steady green light gun signal is displayed, clearing the aircraft to land on runway 07L, wind 080 at 10 knots.

phrases.text: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, position LOTUS, flight level eight zero. We have a dual hydraulic failure, flight controls degraded, flaps and slats inoperative. Request radar vectors for ILS runway zero seven left, final approach speed one eight zero knots, unable to vacate runway under own power.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares urgency (PAN PAN x3), reports a dual hydraulic failure with degraded flight controls and inoperative flaps/slats, and requests radar vectors for ILS runway 07L at a final approach speed of 180 knots, unable to vacate the runway under own power.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, PAN PAN acknowledged. Cleared direct CANTO, descend and maintain three thousand feet, QNH one zero one eight. High approach speed approved, priority for runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the PAN PAN, clears the aircraft direct to CANTO, descend and maintain 3,000 feet, QNH 1018, approves the high approach speed, and gives priority for runway 07L.

phrases.text: Direct CANTO, descend three thousand feet, QNH one zero one eight, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the clearance: direct CANTO, descend 3,000 feet, QNH 1018.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, report when ready for approach, advise if you require emergency equipment on arrival.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Asks the pilot to report when ready for the approach and to advise whether emergency equipment is required on arrival.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, affirmative, request emergency services on standby. Alternate gear extension completed, gravity down and locked. Expect long landing roll, unable nosewheel steering, will require tug assistance on the runway.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Requests emergency services on standby, confirms alternate (gravity) gear extension completed down and locked, and warns of a long landing roll, no nosewheel steering, and a need for tug assistance on the runway.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Emergency services standing by runway zero seven left, tow tug dispatched to holding point Alpha. Cleared ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms emergency services are standing by at runway 07L, the tow tug is dispatched to holding point Alpha, and clears the aircraft for the ILS to runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cleared ILS runway zero seven left, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the ILS clearance for runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, WINDSHEAR ESCAPE.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory windshear escape call transmitted immediately when executing the escape maneuver; tells ATC standard missed approach procedures are suspended.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, climb straight ahead to four thousand feet. Wind zero nine zero degrees, one eight knots gusting three five knots, microburst alert.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the windshear escape, clears the aircraft to climb straight ahead to 4,000 feet, and reports wind 090 degrees at 18 knots gusting 35 knots with a microburst alert.

phrases.text: Climb straight ahead four thousand feet, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the climb-straight-ahead clearance to 4,000 feet.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, clear of windshear, passing three thousand feet climbing four thousand feet. PIREP, windshear on final approach runway zero seven right, loss of two five knots at six hundred feet, severe turbulence.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports clear of windshear passing 3,000 feet climbing to 4,000 feet, and files a PIREP: windshear on final approach runway 07R, loss of 25 knots at 600 feet, severe turbulence.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, thank you for the report. Contact Hong Kong Radar on one two one decimal three.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Thanks the pilot for the PIREP and instructs contact with Hong Kong Radar on 121.3.

phrases.text: One two one decimal three, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the frequency change to 121.3.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, flight level three five zero. Encountering volcanic ash, engine surging, turning right heading one six zero, descending to flight level two eight zero. Request diversion.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares MAYDAY on encountering volcanic ash at FL350, reports engine surging, and advises the immediate 180° turn to heading 160 with descent to FL280 and a diversion request.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, MAYDAY acknowledged. Right turn heading one six zero approved, descend and maintain flight level two eight zero. Squawk seven seven zero zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, approves the right turn to heading 160, clears descent to FL280, and instructs squawk 7700.

phrases.text: Right turn heading one six zero, descending flight level two eight zero, squawking seven seven zero zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the turn, descent and squawk 7700.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, when able, report aircraft status and intentions.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Asks the crew to report aircraft status and intentions when able.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, clear of ash cloud passing flight level three zero zero. Engines stabilized at flight level two eight zero, sulfur odor clearing. Request diversion to Hong Kong, radar vectors.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports clear of the ash cloud passing FL300, engines stabilized at FL280 with the sulfur odor clearing, and requests diversion to Hong Kong with radar vectors.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Cleared direct CANTO, descend to flight level one six zero, Hong Kong emergency services notified.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clears the aircraft direct to CANTO, descent to FL160, and confirms Hong Kong emergency services have been notified.

phrases.text: Direct CANTO, descending flight level one six zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the direct CANTO clearance and descent to FL160.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, rapid depressurization, EMERGENCY DESCENT, leaving flight level three niner zero for one zero thousand feet, turning right heading zero niner zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares MAYDAY on rapid depressurization, announces an emergency descent from FL390 to 10,000 feet, and advises the right turn to heading 090.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, MAYDAY acknowledged. Emergency descent approved to one zero thousand feet, right turn heading zero niner zero, QNH one zero one six. Squawk seven seven zero zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, approves the emergency descent to 10,000 feet and the right turn to heading 090, gives QNH 1016, and instructs squawk 7700.

phrases.text: Descending one zero thousand feet, heading zero niner zero, QNH one zero one six, squawking seven seven zero zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the descent to 10,000 feet, heading 090, QNH 1016, and squawk 7700.

phrases.text: Attention all aircraft on airway Victor One, emergency descent in progress by Cathay two five one, leaving flight level three niner zero descending to one zero thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Broadcasts to all traffic on airway Victor One that Cathay 251 is in an emergency descent from FL390 to 10,000 feet, clearing the descent corridor.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, leveled off at one zero thousand feet. Cabin altitude stabilized, structural integrity intact, passenger oxygen deployed. Request radar vectors to Hong Kong.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports level at 10,000 feet with cabin altitude stabilized, structure intact and passenger oxygen deployed, and requests radar vectors to Hong Kong.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Turn left heading zero four zero, vectoring for direct Hong Kong runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges and vectors the aircraft left to heading 040, direct to Hong Kong runway 07L.

phrases.text: Left heading zero four zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the left turn to heading 040.

phrases.text: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, gross weight three three zero tonnes, maximum landing weight two five one tonnes. Request fuel jettison over water, require twenty minutes to dump seven zero tonnes.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares PAN PAN on a return-to-field situation, states gross weight 330 tonnes against a 251-tonne maximum landing weight, and requests fuel jettison over water for twenty minutes to dump 70 tonnes.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, PAN PAN acknowledged. Cleared to fuel dumping area South China Sea, maintain flight level one zero zero. Advise when ready to commence fuel jettison.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the PAN PAN, clears the aircraft to the South China Sea fuel dumping area at FL100, and asks to be advised when ready to commence dumping.

phrases.text: Cleared to fuel dumping area, maintain flight level one zero zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the clearance to the fuel dumping area and to maintain FL100.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, established in dumping area flight level one zero zero, COMMENCING FUEL JETTISON.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports established in the dumping area at FL100 and announces fuel jettison is commencing.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Attention all aircraft, fuel dumping in progress by Cathay two five one over South China Sea, flight level one zero zero. Avoid area by ten miles and two thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Broadcasts to all traffic that Cathay 251 is dumping fuel over the South China Sea at FL100 and to avoid the area by 10 miles and 2,000 feet.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, FUEL JETTISON COMPLETED, landing weight two five zero tonnes. Request radar vectors for ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports fuel jettison complete with landing weight 250 tonnes and requests radar vectors for the ILS to runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Turn left heading zero four zero, descend to five thousand feet, vectoring for ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges and vectors the aircraft left to heading 040, descending to 5,000 feet for the ILS to runway 07L.

phrases.text: Left heading zero four zero, descending five thousand feet, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the left turn to heading 040 and descent to 5,000 feet.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Departure, Cathay two five one, passing eight hundred feet. Severe bird strike, number one engine failure, shutting down, squawking seven seven zero zero. Stop climb at three thousand feet, request radar vectors for return runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares MAYDAY on departure, reports a severe bird strike with number one engine failure at 800 feet, squawking 7700, and requests a stop climb at 3,000 feet with radar vectors for a return to runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Departure, MAYDAY acknowledged. Stop climb at three thousand feet, turn left heading zero four zero. You have priority for runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, instructs a stop climb at 3,000 feet and a left turn to heading 040, and confirms priority for runway 07L.

phrases.text: Stop climb three thousand feet, left heading zero four zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the stop climb at 3,000 feet and the left turn to heading 040.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, advise when able number of persons on board, fuel endurance, and report bird details for runway inspection.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Asks the pilot to report souls on board and fuel endurance when able, and to give bird strike details so a runway inspection can be arranged.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, souls on board two hundred and eighty, endurance four hours three zero minutes. Bird strike details: large flock of kites, multiple strikes on radome and number one engine. Recommend immediate runway inspection runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports 280 souls on board and 4 hours 30 minutes fuel endurance, describes a large flock of kites striking the radome and number one engine, and recommends an immediate runway inspection of runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Runway inspection vehicle dispatched, emergency services standing by runway zero seven left. Continue heading zero four zero, vectoring for downwind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms a runway inspection vehicle is dispatched and emergency services are standing by at runway 07L, and continues vectors on heading 040 for downwind.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing flight level one two zero. Number two engine failure, shut down and secured. Right hydraulic system lost, flaps limited to flaps five, approach speed one seven five knots. Request straight-in ILS runway zero seven left, emergency services on standby.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares MAYDAY with a compound failure: number two engine failed and secured, right hydraulic system lost, flaps limited to flaps five with a 175-knot approach speed, and requests a straight-in ILS to runway 07L with emergency services on standby.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, MAYDAY acknowledged. Squawk seven seven zero zero observed. Descend and maintain four thousand feet, QNH one zero one eight. Cleared direct CANTO for straight-in ILS runway zero seven left. You have absolute priority.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, confirms squawk 7700 observed, clears descent to 4,000 feet on QNH 1018, clears direct CANTO for a straight-in ILS to runway 07L, and grants absolute priority.

phrases.text: Descend four thousand feet, QNH one zero one eight, direct CANTO for straight-in runway zero seven left, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the descent to 4,000 feet, QNH 1018, and direct CANTO for the straight-in runway 07L approach.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, report persons on board and fuel endurance, advise if you can vacate under own power.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Asks the pilot to report souls on board and fuel endurance, and whether the aircraft can vacate the runway under its own power.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, souls on board two hundred and sixty, endurance two hours one five minutes. Due hydraulic loss, unable nosewheel steering, will roll to the end and stop on runway centerline. Require tow tug to vacate.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports 260 souls on board and 2 hours 15 minutes fuel endurance, and states that with no nosewheel steering the aircraft will roll to the end and stop on the runway centerline, requiring a tow tug to vacate.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Emergency services standing by runway zero seven left, tow tug on standby. Cleared ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms emergency services are standing by at runway 07L with a tow tug on standby, and clears the aircraft for the ILS to runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, radar contact passing two thousand five hundred feet. Cancel standard instrument departure speed restriction, expedite climb through flight level eight zero. Turn right direct BEKOL, climb and maintain flight level one three zero. Traffic twelve o'clock, five miles, opposite direction, Airbus three three zero descending through flight level one four zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: A compound departure clearance: radar contact at 2,500 feet, cancel the SID speed restriction, expedite climb through FL080, turn right direct BEKOL, climb and maintain FL130, with traffic information on an opposite-direction A330 descending through FL140.

phrases.text: Cancel speed restriction, expedite through flight level eight zero, right direct BEKOL, climb and maintain flight level one three zero. Looking for traffic, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the compound clearance in logical sequence — speed, vertical, lateral — and reports looking for the traffic.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, report traffic in sight, then resume normal speed, contact Guangzhou Control on one two zero decimal six.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Instructs the pilot to report the traffic in sight, then resume normal speed and transfer to Guangzhou Control on 120.6.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, traffic in sight on TCAS, clear of conflict. Resuming normal speed, switching to Guangzhou Control on one two zero decimal six. Good day.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Confirms traffic in sight on TCAS and clear of conflict, resumes normal speed, and switches to Guangzhou Control on 120.6.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, good day.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the frequency transfer with a standard farewell.

phrases.text: Right heading zero six zero, climb flight level one four zero, cancel speed restriction, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct readback of a compound clearance: heading, level, and the mandatory speed-restriction cancellation — speed instructions are mandatory readback items under ICAO Doc 4444 and Annex 10.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Approach, expect holding at ABBEY due to thunderstorm activity over the airfield. Expected approach time zero niner four five.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Holding instruction at ABBEY because of thunderstorms over Hong Kong, with an Expected Approach Time of 0945Z — the time the aircraft is expected to leave the hold for its approach.

phrases.text: Hold at ABBEY, expected approach time zero niner four five, Cathay two five one. Request current weather and runway conditions at Hong Kong.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the holding instruction and EAT, and requests the current weather and runway conditions at Hong Kong.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, surface wind one four zero degrees at two two knots, gusting three four knots, heavy rain, visibility one thousand two hundred meters. Alternate Macao is clear.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Reports surface wind 140 degrees at 22 knots gusting 34, heavy rain, visibility 1,200 metres, and advises that the alternate, Macao, is clear.

phrases.text: Roger, Cathay two five one. We have forty five minutes of holding fuel before minimum diversion fuel. Request one holding pattern at ABBEY, then advise if unable approach.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the weather, states 45 minutes of holding fuel remain before Minimum Diversion Fuel, and requests one holding pattern at ABBEY.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, cleared to hold at ABBEY at flight level one two zero. Report entering the hold.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clears the aircraft to hold at ABBEY at FL120 and asks the pilot to report entering the hold.

phrases.text: Entering the hold at ABBEY, flight level one two zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports entering the hold at ABBEY at FL120.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Approach, Cathay two five one, minimum fuel reached, weather below company minima. Request immediate diversion to Macao via airway Alpha Four Six One, flight level one four zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares MINIMUM FUEL, reports weather below company minima, and requests an immediate diversion to Macao via airway A461 at FL140.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, diversion approved. Cleared direct TAMOT, climb and maintain flight level one four zero, contact Macao Approach on one two three decimal niner five.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Approves the diversion, clears the aircraft direct TAMOT, climb and maintain FL140, and transfers it to Macao Approach on 123.95.

phrases.text: Direct TAMOT, climb flight level one four zero, Macao Approach one two three decimal niner five, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the diversion clearance: direct TAMOT, climb FL140, Macao Approach 123.95.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, FUEL, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct distress declaration when any further delay would leave the aircraft landing with less than Final Reserve Fuel (30 minutes). Unlike MINIMUM FUEL, it immediately grants absolute priority.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, flight level two eight zero, seventy miles south of BETTY. Request deviation two zero miles right of track due embedded thunderstorm cells.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Requests a 20-mile lateral weather deviation right of track around embedded thunderstorm cells, reporting position 70 miles south of BETTY at FL280.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, deviation up to two zero miles right of track approved. Advise when able direct BETTY. Expect severe turbulence and holding at BETTY due typhoon crosswinds at Hong Kong.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Approves a deviation of up to 20 miles right of track, asks the pilot to advise when able to proceed direct BETTY, and warns of severe turbulence and holding at BETTY due to typhoon crosswinds.

phrases.text: Deviation two zero miles right of track approved, will advise when clear of weather, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the deviation approval and confirms the pilot will advise when clear of weather.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong surface wind now zero six zero degrees at three eight knots, gusting five two knots, windshear reported on all approaches. Indefinite holding.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Reports surface wind 060 degrees at 38 knots gusting 52, windshear on all approaches, and indefinite holding — no estimated landing time can be given.

phrases.text: Roger, Cathay two five one. Clear of weather, unable to hold due fuel limits. Request diversion to alternate Taipei via ELATO, climb and maintain flight level three three zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges, reports clear of weather but unable to hold due to fuel limits, and requests diversion to Taipei via ELATO, climbing to FL330.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, diversion to Taipei approved. Cleared direct ELATO, climb and maintain flight level three three zero, contact Taipei Control on one two eight decimal seven when passing ELATO.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Approves the diversion to Taipei, clears the aircraft direct ELATO and climb to FL330, and transfers it to Taipei Control on 128.7 when passing ELATO.

phrases.text: Direct ELATO, climb flight level three three zero, Taipei Control one two eight decimal seven passing ELATO, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the diversion clearance: direct ELATO, climb FL330, Taipei Control 128.7 when passing ELATO.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing flight level two four zero, squawking seven seven zero zero. Captain incapacitated, single pilot operation. Request priority radar vectors for autoland ILS runway zero seven left and medical assistance on arrival.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares a MAYDAY for an incapacitated captain, reports single-pilot operation at FL240 squawking 7700, and requests priority radar vectors for an autoland ILS to runway 07L plus medical assistance on arrival.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, MAYDAY acknowledged. Squawk seven seven zero zero observed. You have absolute priority. Turn left heading zero five zero, descend and maintain eight thousand feet, QNH one zero one seven. Advise if you require slower vectoring for checklist completion.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, confirms the 7700 squawk, grants absolute priority, and issues a left turn to heading 050, descent to 8,000 feet on QNH 1017, offering slower vectoring for checklist completion.

phrases.text: Left heading zero five zero, descending eight thousand feet, QNH one zero one seven, slower vectors appreciated, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the heading, altitude and QNH and accepts the offer of slower vectors for checklist completion.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Reduce speed to two two zero knots, cleared direct CANTO, descend four thousand feet. Medical team and ambulance standing by at Bay Whiskey Four Two.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Reduces speed to 220 knots, clears the aircraft direct CANTO and down to 4,000 feet, and confirms a medical team and ambulance are standing by at Bay W42.

phrases.text: Speed two two zero knots, direct CANTO, descending four thousand feet. Cabin crew assisting on flight deck, autopilot engaged for dual-channel autoland, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the speed, routing and descent, confirms cabin crew are assisting on the flight deck and the autopilot is engaged for a dual-channel autoland.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, cleared ILS runway zero seven left, contact Tower on one one eight decimal two when established.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clears the aircraft for the ILS approach to runway 07L and instructs contact with Tower on 118.2 once established on the localiser.

phrases.text: Cleared ILS runway zero seven left, Tower one one eight decimal two when established, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the ILS clearance for runway 07L and the Tower frequency 118.2 to be contacted when established.

phrases.text: All stations, Hong Kong Control, radar service terminated due equipment failure. Procedural control in effect. Cathay two five one, resume own navigation direct SIERA, maintain flight level one five zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Broadcasts to all aircraft that radar service is terminated due to equipment failure, procedural control is in effect, and instructs Cathay 251 to resume own navigation direct SIERA maintaining FL150.

phrases.text: Radar service terminated, resuming own navigation direct SIERA, maintaining flight level one five zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the radar termination and confirms resuming own navigation direct SIERA while maintaining FL150.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, report passing SIERA with estimate for ABBEY. Maintain flight level one five zero until passing SIERA, then descend to flight level one one zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Instructs the pilot to report passing SIERA with an estimate for ABBEY and to maintain FL150 until passing SIERA before descending to FL110 (conditional level gate).

phrases.text: Wilco, will report passing SIERA with estimate ABBEY, maintain flight level one five zero until SIERA, then descend flight level one one zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges and reads back the position-report instruction and the conditional level gate: FL150 until SIERA, then descend to FL110.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Control, Cathay two five one, position SIERA at time one two one five, leaving flight level one five zero for flight level one one zero, estimating ABBEY at time one two two three.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard four-part ICAO position report: over SIERA at 1215Z, leaving FL150 for FL110, estimating ABBEY at 1223Z.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Hold at ABBEY at flight level one one zero, expect procedural ILS approach runway zero seven left. Expected approach time one two three five.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the position report, instructs a hold at ABBEY at FL110, and gives a procedural ILS approach to runway 07L with an expected approach time of 1235Z.

phrases.text: Hold at ABBEY flight level one one zero, expected approach time one two three five, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the hold at ABBEY at FL110 and the expected approach time of 1235Z.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, STOPPING, runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory concise RTO callout alerting Tower that the takeoff has been aborted and the aircraft remains stopped on runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, roger. All following traffic go around. Advise intentions and if assistance required.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the RTO, orders all following traffic to go around to protect the stopped aircraft, and asks the crew to advise intentions and whether assistance is required.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, stopped on runway zero seven left, number two engine fire, fire handles pulled, both bottles discharged. Request immediate fire services.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares a MAYDAY for a stopped aircraft with a number two engine fire, confirms fire handles pulled and both Halon bottles discharged, and requests immediate fire services.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, MAYDAY acknowledged. Fire services dispatched, approaching from the upwind left side. Wind zero eight zero at one two knots. Advise if evacuating and persons on board.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, confirms fire services are dispatched and approaching from the upwind left side, passes wind 080 at 12 knots, and asks whether the crew is evacuating and how many persons are on board.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, fire still burning, EVACUATING on runway zero seven left, left side exits only. Souls on board two hundred and seventy, hazardous cargo nil.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares an emergency evacuation on runway 07L using left-side (upwind, non-fire side) exits only, with 270 souls on board and no hazardous cargo.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, evacuating left side exits only, two seven zero souls on board. Emergency services on scene now, runway zero seven left closed.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Reads back the evacuation with left-side exits only and 270 souls on board, confirms emergency services are on scene, and closes runway 07L.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay two five one, holding short of Taxiway Juliet Three. Report your visual observation at Stand Delta Four.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Ground asks Cathay 251, holding short of Taxiway Juliet Three, to report its visual observation at Stand Delta Four.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay two five one. At Stand Delta Four, a fuel bowser hose has detached beneath the right wing of an Airbus three three zero. Significant jet fuel is pooling on the apron around an active ground power unit.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports a detached fuel bowser hose beneath the A330's right wing at Stand Delta Four, with significant jet fuel pooling on the apron around an active ground power unit.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger. Advise if any personnel are near the spill and if the aircraft APU is running.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the report and asks whether any personnel are near the spill and whether the aircraft APU is running.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, affirmative, two ground crew are standing near the right main landing gear, and the aircraft tail exhaust is shimmering, indicating the APU is running. Request immediate airport fire service dispatch and stand power isolation.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Confirms two ground crew near the right main landing gear and the APU running (shimmering tail exhaust), and requests immediate airport fire service dispatch and stand power isolation.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, fire services and apron safety dispatched to Stand Delta Four. Hold position at Juliet Three, expect revised taxi routing via Kilo to bypass the hazard.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Confirms fire services and apron safety are dispatched to Stand Delta Four, and instructs the aircraft to hold position at Juliet Three and expect revised taxi routing via Kilo to bypass the hazard.

phrases.text: Holding position at Juliet Three, expecting revised taxi via Kilo, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back holding position at Juliet Three and expecting revised taxi routing via Kilo.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Delivery, Cathay two five one, stand Delta Four, information Kilo, request IFR clearance to Macao.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Requests IFR clearance to Macao from Hong Kong Delivery, confirming stand Delta Four and ATIS Kilo.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, cleared to Macao via PECAN One Alpha departure, climb via SID to five thousand feet, squawk three four one two, QNH one zero one six.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clears Cathay 251 to Macao via the PECAN One Alpha SID, climb via SID to 5,000 feet, squawk 3412, QNH 1016.

phrases.text: Cleared Macao, PECAN One Alpha, climb via SID five thousand feet, squawk three four one two, QNH one zero one six, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the full IFR clearance: destination Macao, PECAN One Alpha, climb via SID 5,000 feet, squawk 3412, QNH 1016.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, behind landing Airbus three two zero, line up and wait runway zero seven right behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Conditional line-up clearance: line up and wait on Runway 07R only after the landing Airbus A320 has passed, with the condition and trailing 'behind' both mandatory.

phrases.text: Behind landing Airbus three two zero, line up and wait runway zero seven right behind, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the full conditional line-up clearance, including the condition and the trailing 'behind'.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, turn right heading two eight zero for traffic avoidance, climb to six thousand feet. Report traffic in sight.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tactical traffic-avoidance vector: turn right to heading 280 and climb to 6,000 feet, and report traffic in sight.

phrases.text: Right heading two eight zero, climb six thousand feet, looking for traffic, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the right turn to heading 280 and climb to 6,000 feet, and confirms looking for the traffic.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, clear of traffic, turn left direct ALLEY, cleared ILS runway three four, contact Macao Tower on one one eight decimal zero when established.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clears the aircraft direct to ALLEY for the ILS Runway 34 approach, and to contact Macao Tower on 118.0 once established on the localizer.

phrases.text: Direct ALLEY, cleared ILS runway three four, Macao Tower one one eight decimal zero when established, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back direct ALLEY, cleared ILS Runway 34, and Macao Tower 118.0 when established.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, turn left heading zero niner zero, descend immediately to six thousand feet due traffic.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Radar vectors Cathay 251 left to heading 090 and down to 6,000 feet immediately because of traffic.

phrases.text: UNABLE, Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, TCAS RA, CLIMB.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory callout refusing the ATC descent because a TCAS Resolution Advisory commands a climb; the TCAS RA always takes priority.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, TCAS RA acknowledged.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Controller acknowledges the TCAS RA and must not attempt to modify the aircraft's flight path until the pilot reports clear of conflict.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, clear of conflict, returning to assigned flight level eight zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports the TCAS RA has ended and the aircraft is maneuvering back to its assigned flight level 080.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, turn left heading zero niner zero, descend and maintain four thousand feet, cleared ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clears Cathay 251 left to heading 090, down to 4,000 feet, and for the ILS Runway 07L approach.

phrases.text: Left heading zero niner zero, descending four thousand feet, cleared ILS runway zero seven left, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the left turn to heading 090, descent to 4,000 feet, and the ILS Runway 07L clearance.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, GOING AROUND, unstable approach.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares an aborted landing to Tower because the approach is unstable, using the mandatory go-around call.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, roger, climb straight ahead to four thousand feet, contact Radar on one one niner decimal one.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower acknowledges the go-around, instructs a straight-ahead climb to 4,000 feet, and hands off to Radar on 119.1.

phrases.text: Climb straight ahead four thousand feet, Radar one one niner decimal one, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the straight-ahead climb to 4,000 feet and the Radar frequency 119.1.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, radar contact passing three thousand feet. Cancel SID speed restriction, climb to flight level one four zero, turn right heading zero niner zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Radar establishes contact passing 3,000 feet, cancels the SID speed restriction, and clears Cathay 251 to climb to FL140 on a right turn to heading 090.

phrases.text: Cancel speed restriction, climb flight level one four zero, right heading zero niner zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the speed-restriction cancellation, the climb to FL140, and the right turn to heading 090.

phrases.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, squawking seven seven zero zero. Forward cargo smoke warning, fire bottles discharged, fumes in flight deck, on oxygen. Request immediate return, priority straight-in ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Declares a MAYDAY for a forward cargo smoke warning, reports the fire bottles discharged and the crew on oxygen, and requests an immediate priority straight-in ILS return to Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, MAYDAY acknowledged. Squawk seven seven zero zero observed. Turn left heading two five zero, descend and maintain four thousand feet, QNH one zero one seven. Cleared direct CANTO for straight-in ILS runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Acknowledges the MAYDAY, confirms squawk 7700, and vectors Cathay 251 left to heading 250, down to 4,000 feet, QNH 1017, direct CANTO for the straight-in ILS Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Left heading two five zero, descending four thousand feet, QNH one zero one seven, direct CANTO, Cathay two five one. Souls on board two hundred and fifty, endurance three hours two zero minutes.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the left turn, descent, QNH and direct CANTO, and proactively reports 250 souls on board with 3 hours 20 minutes of fuel endurance.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, wind zero seven zero degrees at one two knots, emergency services on standby, cleared to land runway zero seven left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower reports wind 070 degrees at 12 knots, confirms emergency services are on standby, and clears Cathay 251 to land on Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cleared to land runway zero seven left, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reads back the landing clearance for Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, stopped on runway zero seven left, cargo smoke cleared, no evacuation required, vacating via Hotel Four.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Reports stopped on Runway 07L, the cargo smoke has cleared, no evacuation is required, and the aircraft will vacate via taxiway Hotel Four.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, contact Ground on one two one decimal six, well done.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower acknowledges the vacating report, hands Cathay 251 to Ground on 121.6, and congratulates the crew.
